column1: # BRENT INSTRUMENT REGISTRY — every registered gate / threshold / falsifier declares the instrument it is graded on.
# Read by scripts/instrument_check.py at every boot. LIVE surface — add a row whenever you register a test.
# WHY THIS EXISTS (2026-08-04): five live defects shared one root cause — a test was registered against an
# instrument that was dead, never existed, permanently breached, or could not print inside the window the test
# had to be graded in. None of them was detectable by re-reading the spec; all are detectable by a probe.
#   - DEPLOY GATE v2 leg (a): ^OVX stops at 16:00 and USO options close 16:00 => zero execution window.
#   - Stage-A transit leg: named "real-time AIS" as its LEADING instrument. Never held. Never once evaluated.
#   - Kill-test leg 2: PortWatch chokepoint6 dead since 2026-07-23 while all 25 other chokepoints publish.
#   - Gasoline crack >$30: breached for months, tracked by nothing => a permanently-true tripwire.
#   - VLCC >WS200: no Worldscale feed has ever existed in this kit.
# probe grammar:
#   yf:<TICKER>        yfinance history — checks data returns AND how recent the last bar is
#   fred:<SERIES>      FRED observations — checks last observation date
#   http:<URL>         GET — checks HTTP 200 AND that the body is non-trivial
#   chain:<TICKER>@<EXPIRY>  option chain — checks the expiry exists and quotes are two-sided
#   none               NO INSTRUMENT EXISTS. Always reports 🔴. This is the point.
#   manual:<what>      human-graded; no probe, but last_verified must be inside max_stale_days
# window_req:
#   same_session_action  must be gradeable AND actionable in one session -> co_instrument bounds the action
#   daily / weekly / event   graded off a completed period
# max_stale_days: how old the newest datapoint may be before the test is ungradeable. -1 = n/a (manual/event).
